brief:
An Israeli film examining the country's use of artificial intelligence systems in Gaza received a 25-minute standing ovation at its Venice Film Festival premiere, Al Jazeera English reported. The documentary, titled NAZA, functions as an exposé of Israel's deployment of AI technology during military operations in the territory.

The film's reception at the prestigious festival reflects growing international interest in documentaries addressing the technical and ethical dimensions of contemporary conflict. Venice's decision to screen and honor the work underscores the event's role as a platform for examining contested geopolitical subjects through cinema.
dek: Venice Film Festival honours NAZA, an expose on Israel's use of AI systems in Gaza.
title: Israeli documentary on Gaza AI warfare wins standing ovation at Venice
